main.description: A video post published on a website running Idno: a video on a video sharing service or in another post, or a video file, by its address, with a title and a description.

video.description: The address of the video: its page on the service it is on, or the address of a video file.

provider.description: The service the video is on, when the address is a page on one.

videoRecord.description: When the video is in an AT Protocol record (a Bluesky post, for example), that record.

mimeType.description: The media type of the file, when the address is that of a file.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes, when the address is that of a file.

title.description: The title of the post, if it has one.

text.description: The description of the video, as plain text.

facets.description: Links and hashtags in text, by the range of UTF-8 bytes each covers.

url.description: The address of the post on the site it was published on. This is the original; the record is a copy of it.

tags.description: Tags of the post, without a leading '#', besides any hashtags in text.

langs.description: The human language of the post.

bskyPostRef.description: The Bluesky post (app.bsky.feed.post) that was made for this post, if its author chose to have one.

updatedAt.description: When the post was last changed, if it has been.
